biggest_catch: All amounts are 'up to' maxima for specific protocols - the actual payout depends on completing the study's full protocol, which can be demanding.
catches: All stated amounts are 'up to' figures - no guaranteed minimum per study
Narrow per-study eligibility (right-handed, specific age bands, iPhone/Android, or a close friend co-participant)
In-person participation in the Chicago/Evanston area required
Study procedures and time commitments are not detailed on the page - confirm before enrolling
Availability is per-study; the page rotates as studies fill

notes: Standing recruitment page of Northwestern's NEAR Lab (distinct from R3049 Kellogg behavioral pool - different lab, different department). Page lists three actively recruiting studies with concrete per-study maximum amounts. Payout follows the schema rule for 'up to' amounts with no floor (min 0). Time is not stated on the page; the range is an honest per-study session estimate disclosed as such - the $925 voice study likely involves substantially more time than the minimum.
numeric_basis: payout from official per-study 'up to' maxima (rule: up-to-with-no-floor -> min 0); time: per-study session estimates since the page does not state durations
payout_quote: Study participants can earn up to $925. You and your friend can each earn up to $125. You can earn up to $150, with a chance to earn additional money based on performance.
payout_value_note: Per-study maxima as stated; actual earnings depend on completing each study's protocol.
